Subject: C*-algebras | ID: 36858

Result

Step 2. By the self-adjoint spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01380012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the self-adjoint spectral family.

Step 3. By the idempotent spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01380013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the idempotent spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the nonlinear convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01380011 \cdot C_01380012 \cdot C_01380013\).
